prompt: What can the contributor still meet under the published deadlines?
promptZh: 依公告截止時間，投稿者還來得及做什麼？

options.text: Book a live chat this afternoon, but only without music.
options.zh: 今天下午預約現場訪談，但不能有音樂。
options.whyZh: 星期五中午已過；是否有音樂不會延長預約期限。

options.text: Book a live chat before sending a recording on Sunday.
options.zh: 星期日寄錄音前先預約現場訪談。
options.whyZh: 現場訪談的期限已過，而且不必先預約才能提交錄音。

options.text: Ask the host to convert the current recording into a live chat.
options.zh: 請主持人把現有錄音改為現場訪談。
options.whyZh: 公告沒說轉換形式可繞過已過的預約期限。

options.text: Submit a corrected spoken postcard by Sunday night.
options.zh: 在星期日晚上前提交修正的口述明信片。
options.whyZh: 她在星期五下午一點寫備註，已過現場預約期限，但仍可按時完成不超過 60 秒的錄音。

explanationZh: 她在星期五下午一點寫備註，已過現場預約期限，但仍可按時完成不超過 60 秒的錄音。
evidence: A spoken postcard is a recording of 60 seconds or less and must be submitted by Sunday night. / book it by Friday at noon. / I’m writing this on Friday at 1 p.m. My draft is a forty-five-second account of the old tram shed.

book it by Friday at noon.

vocabulary.note: 把文件或錄音正式交給主辦者。
